text:
mira_partnerships: Heads-up from NorthStar Rack  partial manifest short for CNTR-NS-332. APAC reserved pool for SKU RWD-300 down ~30 units. This touches a marketplace batch + one SI pilot. Need mitigation brainstorming.

inventory-bot: Alert: SKU RWD-300 | region: APAC | reserved: 90 | on_hand: 60 | missing: 30 | snapshot: 2026-03-21T17:00:00Z :warning:

tom_logistics: On it. Can we get ASN and PO? If it's short-pick we can either airlift up to 28 units in 72h (+30% cost) or swap from EMEA pool and fast-track customs. Both have trade-offs.

anya_product: EMEA units (RWD-300B) have slightly different firmware—measured ~6% latency increase on 8k contexts. Acceptable for non-latency SLAs but not for the SI pilot.

sam_sales: Which customers are impacted? SI pilot is high-touch; need to message them privately. Marketplace holds: 40 units reserved for immediate orders.

mira_partnerships: Quick export from reservations: `rwd-cli reservations export --sku RWD-300 --region apac --status reserved` -> shows pilot:16, marketplace:14. Missing 30 hits both.

finance-bot: Provisional airlift budget OK up to +35% for customer-critical where sales signs off. Need a ticket and receipts.

tom_logistics: NorthStar says manifest short due to packing-line equipment fault; can release 10 units this vessel, remainder next vessel ETA 2026-04-04. Airlift avail for 28 units ETA 2026-03-24.

mira_partnerships: Proposal: 1) Airlift 16 units to cover SI pilot fully (finance approved), 2) Offer marketplace buyers either delay 5 days with 3% credit or substitute RWD-300B with clear perf note. 3) Pause any joint public announcement until pilot confirmed.

anya_product: Confirmed: pilot requires original SKU. Approve airlift for 16 units. Marketplace substitution is ok with note.

sam_sales: Messaging to pilot lead ready: "We identified a supplier manifest issue. We're expediting 16 units via air at our cost to avoid disruption. We'll follow up with delivery ETA and tracking." Sending now.

mira_partnerships: Booked airlift (ref: NS-AIR-221). ETA 2026-03-24. Cost delta +31%. Updating reservations and notifying NorthStar to prioritize the release.

inventory-bot: Post-booking snapshot: reserved:90 | on_hand:70 | in_transit_air:16 | pending_supplier:14 | snapshot:2026-03-21T17:30:00Z

mira_partnerships: Closing note: pilot covered, marketplace options communicated, public joint announcement on hold until physical receipts or explicit customer approvals. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
